reviewConclusions: Open offline conflicts block central matchView mutation permissions, including direct overview projections. Server transaction guard remains authoritative.

Stale offline requests require the accepted receipt at the exact claimed revision proving writer authority or the actual own per-player undo authority; never-writer/host requests fail before revision or pause change.
Additional offline commands cannot claim the already frozen canonical revision or a later revision; originals and immutable canonical reference remain private match-ACL data.

Ranking publication pause keeps the public generation pointer stable while rebuilding a pending generation. Per-list ordered locking, fresh role checks and receipt identity preserve retries and independent-list progress.

Primary correction graph includes actual pool decision relations and retains independent branches. Domain agent separately reports 8/8 actual tournament-management DB proof in /tmp/dartflow-tournament-correction-proof.log; that separate run is not included in the 25 count.
